powers.label: Shrek Power — Comedy Ascension (Tenaga Kekacauan)
powers.contentStatus: Shrek power requested; name authored; repeat funny-spin bonus clarified by user
powers.scope: Every later committed funny-result spin adds +1 numeric point to all five main stats through the declared hook.
powers.masteryPolicy: The user-defined passive point reward is active on acquisition; Power Mastery still resolves later and does not silently change the +1 reward.
powers.sourcePolicy: Shrek is an Ogre reference; this named power and stat mechanic are game inventions.
powers.powerTierReason: Pertumbuhan berulang dari actual funny spin; tidak menciptakan realitas.

shrekContract.strongestProfile: Shrek is the intended strongest Orc-wheel profile through repeat five-stat growth. Actual final rolls and mastery remain independent.

hook.status: user-confirmed repeat bonus per funny spin
hook.activeWhen: Character owns the active Shrek Power profile
hook.qualifies: A later actual committed spin outcome has the catalog mechanics tag funny-result.
hook.start: Only results after Shrek Power acquisition; no acquisition bonus or retroactive bonus.
hook.timing: After applying the committed outcome, apply this hook before making its reaction/context snapshot.
hook.consumptionKey: runId + hookId + qualifying spin invocation ID
hook.repeat: Once for every distinct qualifying spin, even across several later stages. Re-rendering, fixed reveals, memes, captions, and repeated evaluation do not count as new spins.
hook.powerMastery: The user-defined passive point reward is active on acquisition; Power Mastery still resolves later and does not silently change the +1 reward.
hook.loopPolicy: The hook adds five modifiers, not another spin; its own modifiers cannot trigger it again.
hook.truth: A narrator saying an outcome is funny cannot add the mechanics tag or activate this hook.

funnyWeaponPool.placementStatus: Design interpretation: use this funny pool for the normal main Weapon spin when Shrek is active; do not manufacture a separate race-stage spin.
funnyWeaponPool.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.

shrekContract.otherFunnySpins: Any later catalog-tagged funny-result spin can qualify, not just this weapon pool. Other funny entries need explicit approved tags.

bonusSpinContract.register: A role result records a stage bonus ticket with its source invocation and component slot; register each once.
bonusSpinContract.sequence: At the target stage: main acquisition spin and its immediate details -> each pending bonus acquisition spin and details -> mastery for every owned instance still unresolved -> eligible weapon enchantment -> next main stage.
bonusSpinContract.eligibility: Freeze fresh odds at each bonus spin using current build/declared eligible pool. Do not carry a race-stage frozen weapon/power draw.
bonusSpinContract.idempotence: Consume the ticket when its bonus result commits; resuming cannot create a second spin or erase earlier grants.

warrior.emptyOutcomePolicy: Exclude None/no-weapon results before drawing because the user requests an extra weapon. Error if no eligible weapon remains.

shaman.emptyOutcomePolicy: The extra spin uses the normal Power outcome rules, including None if the approved pool allows it. The request guarantees a spin, not an extra power regardless of result.

bonusSpinContract.lateActivation: If a role ticket is acquired after its target stage, dispatch its acquisition/mastery subflow from the current caller and return; never restart the main sequence.

contextContract.facts: Narration receives the current as-of-spin committed projection, including actual hook effects and command position, rather than unconditional template claims.

contextContract.army: Before Goblin position, control is unresolved. After Kacung, controlledArmyCount is zero.
contextContract.timing: Outcome, stage-ticket consumption, and hook effects/keys commit together, then context is built.
